name: miami
title: Miami
description: Ocean Drive at nightfall in dots: art deco hotels with soft neon on their stepped parapets, palms in silhouette, the glass towers of Brickell in blue haze and a bay holding the neon in broken reflections.

name: tokyo
title: Tokyo
description: Tokyo at night in coloured dots: Tokyo Tower glowing orange and white with both decks lit, a deep city in faint cyan haze and a moonlit, snow-capped Mount Fuji under a teal sky.

name: new-york
title: New York
description: Manhattan at dusk across the East River: the Empire State Building's lit spire, the Chrysler crown and One World Trade Center against an amber-to-blue sky, with soft window light, broken reflections and a slow ferry.

name: paris
title: Paris
description: Paris at a clear blue hour in dots: a cobalt sky over cool stone rooftops and the dome of Les Invalides, and the Eiffel Tower lit gold in a soft halo as the one warm light, its long reflection in the Seine.

name: london
title: London
description: Westminster at dusk in dots: the Elizabeth Tower's clock face glowing warm, the palace roofline lit gold, Westminster Bridge and its lamps, and the Thames holding long broken reflections under a misty gold to slate sky.

name: dubai
title: Dubai
description: Dubai at dusk from the desert in dots: the Burj Khalifa rising far above a cluster of towers in blue haze, its stepped spire gold in the last light, over rose and amber dunes under a gold-to-blue sky.

name: san-francisco
title: San Francisco
description: The Golden Gate Bridge at blue hour in halftone dots: Art Deco towers in International Orange catching the last light, fog rolling under the deck and over the Marin Headlands, city lights on the far shore and the bay mirroring the afterglow.

name: hong-kong
title: Hong Kong
description: Victoria Harbour at blue hour in coloured dots: lit towers climbing to the misty ridge of Victoria Peak, the Bank of China Tower and Two IFC, long reflections and a red-sailed junk under a magenta to deep blue sky.

name: rio
title: Rio de Janeiro
description: Rio de Janeiro at dusk from the water in dots: Sugarloaf beside Morro da Urca with one cable car crossing, Christ the Redeemer pale on Corcovado, and the lamps of Copacabana curving along the shore under a gold to violet sky.

name: sydney
title: Sydney
description: Sydney Harbour at blue hour in halftone dots: the Opera House's sails catching a warm glow, the Harbour Bridge with its lamps lit, the city in cool haze and the harbour mirroring them under a peach afterglow.
